author: evoule

title: Why it needs access internet?
body:
Habitica is quite nice, fun to “play”. 
What is my issue with the app is why it does not work with a VPN?! It’s the only app that does not work with my vpn (warp). 
Why does it need to access the internet everyday at all? 
When I open Habitica on a new day, with vpn it’s still loading. When I disable vpn, it loads and I progress to the new day.
author: kadoocz

title: Many bugs
body: I love habitica on the web, but the app is big disappointment... it still doesn’t show daily habits for current day, and the gear and stable pages are not updating with the website. I would also enjoy if singing up in the app would be counted to the “singing up strike” (I don’t know how it is called properly, but it shows everytime I sing up using web browser)... todo list and habits (the +/ - ones) are great, the rest needs lots of work...

title: Great!
body:
Neat idea 😎 This app really makes me do my To-Do’s & stick to my habits! 👌🏽

I guess it’s not for everyone - but if you like either RPG’s or D&D, give it a shot! 🤓

P.S.: And the whole project is open source! ❤️❤️❤️

author: Petrgon

title: Geniální gamifikace každodenní rutiny
body: Ať už se snažíte přimět pravidelně cvičit, potřebujete "checklist" svých každodenních úkolů, hledáte nový funkční úkolníček nebo třeba nové výzvy, Habitica funguje. Možná ne na každého, ale bojovat plněním úkolů proti příšerám a dostávat za odměnu expy, zlaťáky, vybavení a další odměny mě motivuje dost.
